name: Fan Tan
summary: Shedding card game where players build four suit sequences outward from the sevens to empty their hand first.
rules_text: Use a 52-card pack. Deal all cards one by one clockwise; some players may have one card extra. Build four rows on the table, one per suit. A seven starts a row for its suit in the middle. Other cards can be added to its row only if they are immediately adjacent in rank to an existing card of that same suit, extending low toward 2 on one side and high toward Ace on the other. Player to dealer's left starts and turns go clockwise. On your turn you must play exactly one playable card if you have any; you may choose among your playable cards. If you have no card that can be placed next to the layout, you must pass. First player to play all cards wins.
rating_reason: Layout shedding game, sequential choice to empty hand
